links.comparator_used: Expert-created responses without LLM drafts (Expert alone)
links.outcome: Quality and empathy scores of responses to retina patient questions, plus time to produce a response
links.effect: Expert + AI quality 3.86 ± 0.85 (best overall); Expert ranked 4/7 for quality and 6/7 for empathy; Expert + AI better than Expert for quality and empathy (both P < 0.001); time savings for expert-edited LLM vs expert-created response (P = 0.02)
links.quote: For both quality (P < 0.001) and empathy (P < 0.001), expert-edited LLM responses performed better than expert-created responses.

links.comparator_used: Unedited LLM responses (five LLMs: ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Claude 2, Bing, Bard)
links.outcome: Quality and empathy of responses to retina patient questions
links.effect: Quality: Expert + AI 3.86 ± 0.85 vs top LLM GPT-3.5 3.75 ± 0.79. Empathy: GPT-3.5 3.75 ± 0.69 vs Expert + AI 3.73 ± 0.63. Significant differences among the groups (P < 0.001 for both).
links.quote: For quality, Expert + AI (3.86 ± 0.85) performed the best overall while GPT-3.5 (3.75 ± 0.79) was the top performing LLM.

design_hint: expert clinician editing of LLM-generated responses
